page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top centre above the text. Main text in one column. Right-hand brace annotations "Miserere nobis" and "Ora pro nobis" stand in the right margin beside the litany lines. Bottom: a catchword "Sancte" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: quæ sequuntur, & ostendunt, quàm horrenda atq; abominabilis Sanctorum invocatio in Ecclesia Romana pseudocatholica, etiam num hodie retineatur.
main_text.head: LITANIA OMNIVM Sanctorum.
main_text.p: Kyrie Eleyson. Christe Eleyson, Kyrie Eleyson.
Pater de cœlis Deus, Miserere nobis
Omnes Sancti Angeli & Archangeli, Orate pro nobis.
Sancte Johannes Baptista, Ora pro nobis.
Omnes Sancti Patriarchæ & Prophetæ, Orate pro nobis.

page.notes: Marginal brace annotations are "Miserere nobis" (spanning Fili to Spiritus lines) and "Ora pro nobis" (spanning the Maria to Raphael lines); placed as notes at the approximate points. Word "Redemtor" as printed with "Redemtormundi" joined; the line break reads "Redemtor mundi,De-us". Catchword "Sancte" is partly obscured at the right.
